summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Copa Holdings, S.A., a Panama-based foreign private issuer, reporting preliminary monthly traffic statistics for May 2026. The filing contains no transaction, corporate action, or special situation. It simply discloses capacity (ASM), traffic (RPM) and load factor data with year-over-year comparisons. There is no offer, deal, shareholder vote, or strategic change. As a non-US foreign issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this is the equivalent of an earnings or operational update. No special-situation classification applies.
